premise: The product-intent confirmation record. For each supplied link: the ASIN the site intends to link to, the official listing URL, the date that intent was recorded, and where it came from. What the short link actually did is recorded separately and is never merged into these fields.
rules: intended.* is a decision: this is the listing the site means to send readers to.
observed.* is an observation: this is what the short link served when it was fetched.
intended.* stays null until the owner confirms the product in the Associates workflow. A redirect target is an observation, not a confirmation of intent.
A later re-check is recorded in its own block. It never overwrites the original dated observation, and it is never treated as a finding about the product.
If intended and observed ever disagree, both are published and the disagreement becomes a flagged item. Neither is overwritten.
No value in this file is inferred from a title, a URL slug, or a sibling product.
